what: nhà mái ngói cam bên đường Hạ Long, the square hall with a pyramid roof of orange tiles by Hạ Long, next to the tower of Khách sạn Hoa Tiêu
uses: Plan 0026, R7: on its OSM outline (way 225803473, a square of 19 m) by Hạ Long; it is in the shot S1 and in the walk PT-74. In place of its stand-in.

photos.author: trungydang
photos.shows: The beach to the south: the hall with a square roof of orange tiles and white ridges by Hạ Long, its cream front with arched windows, its fence with blue posts, flags; Khách sạn Bưu điện, the tower of Khách sạn Hoa Tiêu, the hotels on the slope of Núi Nhỏ.

photos.author: Tuong Lam Photos
photos.shows: From a drone over Hạ Long near Khách sạn Bưu điện, to the west: the tower of Khách sạn Hoa Tiêu, a stepped block with curved grey roofs, a building with a square roof of orange tiles by the road, Hạ Long with its sea wall and Norfolk pines, the houses and hotels on the slope of Núi Nhỏ, the jetty of Cầu Đá with boats.

photos.date: 2019-04-30 (in the file name of the photo)
photos.author: Tuổi Trẻ
photos.shows: The beach of Bãi Trước full of people at the end of the afternoon, to the south: people on the sand and in the water, swim rings, a light blue lamp pole, Khách sạn Bưu điện, the tower of Khách sạn Hoa Tiêu, the stepped block, the orange tile roof, the hill Núi Nhỏ.

checks: Views: front, three quarters, from above (the drone photo 1), far (from the beach 500 m away).
A square hall of 19 m under one pyramid roof of orange tiles with white ridges; cream walls with tall arched windows in brown frames; a lighter porch on the front.
The height to the top of the roof is 10.1 m ± 1.0 m.
